title: Lens-changer
goalLine: Predict the up-down tally after using the lens-changer twice.

hints.text: The lens-changer turns certainty into an even split, but pressing it again reverses the effect.
Two presses of the lens-changer return the parcel back to its starting state.

events.coin-flip-mistake: Expecting two presses to be a coin flip again forgets that the tool is self-reversing.

removePhysicsNote: If the lens-changer were purely random noise, pressing it twice could never restore certainty.
